metaDescription: Professional Jaguar engine rebuild service — complete strip-down, machining, assembly and testing. All models including XJ, XK, XE, XF, F-Type and more.
lede: Complete engine rebuild service for every Jaguar model – from classic XJ to modern F-Type.

sections.heading: What a Jaguar Engine Rebuild Involves

blocks.html: A full engine rebuild returns your Jaguar's engine to original specification — no shortcuts, no generic parts. The process is methodical and comprehensive:

items: Crankshaft inspection and grinding if needed
Reconditioning of cylinder heads (valves, seats, guides)
New pistons, rings, bearings and timing components
Precision assembly with factory torque specs
Pre-oil and leak testing before installation

blocks.html: Every rebuild is backed by a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty and uses OEM-specification parts.

paras: **Rebuilds start from £1,900** (4-cylinder legacy engines). Prices vary by engine type and complexity – see our [pricing disclaimer](/pricing-legal-disclaimer) for details.

blocks.html: We provide a fixed-price quote after a thorough inspection – no hidden extras.
We offer full engine rebuilds across the entire Jaguar range – including both modern and classic engines.
Specific variant examples we work on:

steps.title: Vehicle Reception
steps.body: We receive your Jaguar, drain fluids and prepare for engine removal.

steps.title: Engine Removal
steps.body: Carefully remove the engine, labelling every connection for accurate refit.

steps.title: Strip-down & Inspection
steps.body: Full strip-down, cleaning and detailed measurement of all components.

steps.title: Machining & Parts
steps.body: Boring, honing, grinding and selection of OEM-spec parts.

steps.title: Reassembly
steps.body: Precision assembly using factory torque settings and timing tools.

steps.title: Testing & Installation
steps.body: Pre-oil, leak test, refit, road test – then handover.

items.q: How long does a Jaguar engine rebuild take?
items.a: Typical turnaround is 1-4 weeks, depending on the engine complexity, parts availability and machine shop workload. We'll give you a realistic estimate after inspection.

items.q: What is included in the rebuild price?
items.a: Our fixed-price quote covers all parts (pistons, rings, bearings, gaskets, timing components, etc.), machining, assembly, testing, and installation. We also include a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

items.q: Do you offer a warranty on rebuilt engines?
items.a: Yes – every rebuild comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty. Terms are explained in our [warranty policy](/warranty).

items.q: Can you rebuild any Jaguar engine?
items.a: We cover all production Jaguar engines – from the AJ-V6, AJ-V8, AJ133, AJ126, Ingenium, to older ZSD and AJ-series. If you're unsure, contact us with your registration.

items.q: Do you supply engines without fitting?
items.a: No – we are a garage that fits every engine we rebuild or supply. We do not offer stand-alone engine sales.
